text: 10月物价能源涨食品降，PPI和CPI剪刀差扩至5% 生产端价格涨势更多集中于部分上游行业，消费端价格仍受食品偏弱等因素牵制。
text_en: October prices: energy up, food down; PPI-CPI scissors gap widens to 5%. Producer price gains are increasingly concentrated in some upstream industries, while consumer prices remain weighed down by factors such as weak food prices.
